units: pixels, seconds; x to the right, y down; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (frame 0 vs frame 25 mean |diff| 0.73 grey levels, max 27 = compression/lighting noise; background features do not shift)
camera.view: side view through a large brick/wood arch onto a subway track; train moves right-to-left across the image, parallel to the image plane
camera.perspective_note: Train passes very close to the camera, so its near side wall and its far side (seen through the windows, and the end faces) move at clearly different pixel rates: far/near pixel scale ratio = 0.72 (Z_near/Z_far, from matched features: 249.6/347, 254.6/353.4, 276.9/386.0). The train's origin (body centre, mid-depth) has pixel scale K = 0.837 x near-side scale (assuming origin halfway between near and far side). Principal point assumed at x=960 for the end-corner perspective model; checked: predicted end-face edges agree with observed edges to within ~10-15 px in frames 2,3,4,19,20.

objects.name: train
objects.description: dark subway car / train with rounded silver-framed windows, door with two narrow windows; graffiti (blue 'otm' tag, red/white sticker, 'NOT AGAIN', white 'AKC') visible through the windows on the far side; front end face graffiti-covered silver panel lit by the lamp (frames 3-4)
objects.length_note: length front-to-rear corner of the near side wall from front corner (f4 x=1511, f6 x=810) and rear corner (f17 x=1479; f19 x~700 gives 4775) plus integrated near-side shifts; longer than the image width (never fully visible). Pair the length and the shifts of the SAME layer: length/shift ratio is layer independent.
objects.near_side_shift_px_per_frame: 353.4 (frame 6) rising linearly to 391.1 (frame 18); straight-line fit d(i) = 334.10 + 3.199 i (rms 0.8 px), i = frame index, d(i) = x(i-1) - x(i)
objects.visible_vertical_extent_px: clipped by the arch: visible from y~330-450 (depends on x, arch curve) down to the arch's lower beam y~865; window band y 455-740 (big windows), door windows y 505-747; roof and wheels not visible
objects.big_window_size_near_px: about 345 wide x 285 high (e.g. frame 6 x 1280-1625, y 455-740)
objects.reference_point: origin = body centre; never visible (off-screen or mid-train); listed in track as near_centre_x (near-side layer) and origin_x_mid_depth (projected at mid depth)

objects.name: arch
objects.description: large dark brown semicircular arch frame in the foreground through which the track is seen
objects.image_extent_px: outer ring x~100-1920+, opening from x~310 (left at window height) to beyond right edge; top of opening y~200; lower beam y~865-900

objects.name: central_pillar
